turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got some gift money and I want to pick a new game.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold your thoughts until I've described all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is a huge open world fantasy game, like a hundred hours long, with gorgeous graphics.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a short indie puzzle game, maybe six hours, that everyone says is really clever.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is an online shooter my friends play every night, but it's full of microtransactions.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a cozy farming game where you grow crops and decorate a little house.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you want to play with your friends, the shooter is the obvious pick, even with the extra purchases. The fantasy game is great value if you have lots of free time. The puzzle game is perfect if you just want something short and satisfying.
